name: Linear Air
roleBasis: Its homepage offers "Find and book private charter flights anywhere", cites "7000+ available aircraft" and frames itself against "charter broker hassles". It does not say plainly whether it operates aircraft.
summary: Instant-booking charter site that prices each trip all-in and lists typical add-on fees with dollar ranges.
differentiator: Says "all costs are included in the price you see" instead of an hourly rate, and prints dollar ranges for crew overnight fees, per diem, wait time, de-icing and repositioning that most providers describe only in words.
priceNote: The hourly table is a general market guide on its how-it-works page. Its own pricing is all-inclusive per trip and shown after a search.
operatorDisclosure: Not stated on the pages we read.
bestFor: Buyers who want an all-in trip price at search time and a list of typical add-on fees.
skipIf: You want its own hourly rate card. The table is a market guide.
